notes.title: Full Steam Deck support.
notes.content: [p]Salam alaikum batyrs and jigitki. 😎  [/p][p][/p][p]1. The game is fully compatible with the Steam Deck.  [/p][p][/p][p]2. It runs with full gamepad support.  [/p][p][/p][p]3. On minimum settings, you can expect around 60 FPS. [/p][p][/p][p]4. Steam Deck OLED users can enable HDR in the graphics settings if they wish.[/p]
